question: Who among the following is the wife of Chandragupta I.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumaradevi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandragupta I's wife was Kumaradevi, **a princess from the Lichchhavi dynasty of present-day Nepal
 
• **Chandragupta I's marriage to Kumaradevi may have helped him expand his political power and territory.**
 
• He was able to adopt **the title of Maharajadhiraja,** which means "the true king of his people".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chandragupta I:(reigned circa 320–335 CE)**

 
 
• Chandragupta I is credited with laying the foundation of the Gupta Empire, which would later be regarded as the "Golden Age" of ancient India.
 
• He was succeeded by his son, Samudragupta, who would go on to greatly expand the Gupta Empire.
